description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonGrain functionality within the Event Sourcing context, including tests for activation, persistence, event appending, and state transitions.

classes.name: PersonGrainTests
classes.description: Unit tests for PersonGrain behaviors, including activation, persistence, event appending, and state management, using xUnit testing framework.

methods.name: JournaledGrainTests_Activate
methods.description: Tests that a grain can be activated and its tentative personal attributes can be retrieved.

methods.name: JournaledGrainTests_Persist
methods.description: Tests that a birth registration updates the grain state with given attributes and that they can be retrieved correctly.

methods.name: JournaledGrainTests_AppendMoreEvents
methods.description: Creates two grains representing individuals, registers their birth attributes, and verifies that marriage updates the attributes accordingly.

methods.name: JournaledGrainTests_TentativeConfirmedState
methods.description: Tests the state transition from tentative to confirmed state inside the grain, ensuring deterministic behavior.
